title: Iron Gate — 18-Stage Production Marathon
description: Capstone track framed as one mission (~2–3 hours): build and harden a RAG stack, then red-team and blue-team the assistant. Each stage is a graded LabPath exercise; the path preserves order and progress. Not a single combined grader (yet).

stages.title: Cost-Capped Retrieval
stages.goal: Hit recall under a token/call budget — no brute-force retrieval.

stages.title: Recall@k SLA on Policy KB
stages.goal: Chunk size/overlap tradeoff for policy recall@5.

stages.title: Overlap Tune
stages.goal: Dial overlap without blowing context windows.

stages.title: Citation-Grounded Answers
stages.goal: Answers must cite the right span; hallucinations fail Class B.

stages.title: Span Match
stages.goal: Retrieve boundaries that exactly cover gold spans.

stages.title: Two-Stage Retrieve + Rerank
stages.goal: Fix nDCG@5 with rerank/rewrite under call caps.

stages.title: Query Fit
stages.goal: Query rewriting/expansion that helps hard questions only.

stages.title: Custom Retriever (Sandbox)
stages.goal: Ship Python retriever code to recall@5 ≥ 0.80.

stages.title: Spend Cap
stages.goal: Pipeline must respect spend abuse limits.

stages.title: Eval Slice Regression Gate
stages.goal: Define eval slice; block regressions on Wilson gates.

stages.title: Indirect Injection via Retrieval
stages.goal: Red-team: poisoned chunks that hijack the agent.

stages.title: Obfuscation & Encoding Bypass
stages.goal: Break encodings; blue-team must still block.

stages.title: PII & Secret Canary Detection
stages.goal: Extract/canary traps — block exfil without killing UX.

stages.title: Tool Argument Validation
stages.goal: Smuggled tool args must never reach execution.

stages.title: Supply-Chain Prompts in Documents
stages.goal: Document-embedded system prompts in the corpus.

stages.title: Defense in Depth (Rules + Judge)
stages.goal: Layer rules + judge; pass Wilson on attacks and benign.

stages.title: FP/FN Tradeoff at Scale
stages.goal: Tune thresholds for production-scale Wilson gates.

stages.title: Multi-Turn Jailbreak Escalation
stages.goal: Final boss: slow multi-turn jailbreak vs your stack.
